(2) The scene cuts to the interior of a FamilyMart convenience store, focusing on a promotional poster for an 'Okinawa Limited' Almond Milk Latte. The poster features a close-up of the drink with almonds. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a retail environment. (3) The camera zooms in on the coffee machine's interface, showing specific buttons for hot and cold almond milk lattes, highlighted by red and blue graphic arrows. narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to highlight the unique, region-exclusive products found only in FamilyMart convenience stores in Okinawa. By showing items like almond milk lattes, bitter melon jam, and Awamori coffee, it positions Okinawa as a distinct travel destination with its own specific retail culture, encouraging viewers to visit and explore these local specialties.
